prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Helpful changes: Adoption visual and style enhancements (style selectors, pre-upload inspection, photo callouts, compact grids), split-view path layouts, generation tip carousels and setup checklists, desktop readiness hints, session safeguard hints, post-waiting auth reorders, clear desktop control copy, and compact welcome dashboards.
Hurt performance: Pre-adoption prep screens, pre-certificate or post-certificate sign-in reorders, path decision speed callouts, path copy changes, instant activation incentives, story scroll intros, and desktop finish guidance banners or spotlight redesigns.
No clear effect seen: Audio and background notifications, account sync and persistence verification flows, waiting progress overlays, adoption incentive badges, and carousel or two-column path layouts.
Predictions were too low: Pre-upload style inspection, photo quality callouts, compact welcome dashboards, clear desktop control copy, and session safeguard hints performed significantly better than predicted.
Predictions were too high: Preset fast-track adoption flows, pre-certificate sign-in reorders, instant activation highlights, desktop finish redesigns, and all tests that yielded negative performance or no clear effect were overpredicted.

Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] Grid Layout Desktop Controls Companion Redesign: Rebuild the home intro screen using a grid layout with explicit visual cards demonstrating tray shortcuts and desktop pet controls. (why: 3 support tickets cited confusion on how to control or hide the pet, and 28.1% of users drop off between home and finish.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Companion Photo Framing Inspection View: Insert a dedicated photo alignment preview screen between upload_photos and adoption_certificate to verify portrait clarity before rendering. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or distorted pet visuals, and adoption mean duration is high (1017s).)
2: [sign_in, redesign] Account Session Safeguard Redesign: Redesign the sign-in screen into a compact safeguard view with prominent session persistence badges and recovery guidance. (why: 8 support emails (the top issue) reported pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
3: [home, new_flow] Background Rendering Readiness Checklist Flow: Transform the waiting screen into an interactive checklist flow that tracks background desktop integration and tray placement. (why: Home step has a long mean wait of 2336s and 3 support emails reported pets not appearing on the desktop.)
4: [finish, copy] Clear Pet Desktop Controls Copy: Update the home intro body copy to explicitly instruct users how to hide, reveal, and interact with the desktop pet. (why: 3 support tickets highlighted post-onboarding confusion regarding hiding or talking to the pet.)
5: [home, hint] Desktop Tray Visibility Background Hint: Add a prominent hint on the waiting screen explaining where the pet icon will appear in the system tray once rendering finishes. (why: 3 support emails reported pets missing from desktop or failing to open after setup.)
6: [home, wait_info] Generation Tip Carousel Component Stage: Integrate an interactive tip carousel component into the waiting view to engage users while pet assets generate. (why: Home wait time has a high mean (2336s) and median (201s), causing drop-off before completion.)
7: [choose_path, hint] Path Selection Reassurance Hint: Add a reassuring hint on the path selection screen confirming that companion paths can be changed later. (why: Choose path takes a mean 514s and loses 16.5% of users at the start of onboarding.)
8: [adoption, redesign] Compact Photo Selection Studio Layout: Redesign the upload photos screen using a compact studio layout with photo quality badges and instant visual feedback. (why: 3 support emails reported pet generation errors and custom pets looking wrong.)
9: [adoption, redesign] Split View Pet Selector Studio: Redesign the pick_friend screen into a split view comparing companion visual archetypes side-by-side. (why: Adoption step has a high mean duration of 1017s; visual side-by-side comparison speeds up selection.)
